title: String Value Entity v1
description: Payload for a title, synopsis, episode body, episode memo, or chapter title EntityKey.
$comment: maxLength counts Unicode scalar values. A pure semantic validator also caps the raw UTF-8 value at 1048576 bytes so every valid known Snapshot remains exportable as novelpkg v3. The separately enforced canonical UTF-8 entity-object limit is 16777216 bytes. No Unicode normalization or line-ending conversion is permitted before hashing.
